label: MikroTik cAP ax (cAPGi-5HaxD2HaxD)
description: MikroTik cAP ax - ceiling 802.11ax access point, 2x 1G RJ45 (802.3af/at PoE-in on either port, passive PoE-out on ether2), dual-band 574 Mbit/s on 2.4 GHz and 1200 Mbit/s on 5 GHz.
notes: Vendor figures: 2x 10/100/1000 Ethernet ports, 1 with PoE-out; wireless 2.4 GHz 574 Mbit/s (802.11b/g/n/ax) and 5 GHz 1200 Mbit/s; PoE-in 802.3af/at on 18-57 V. **The PoE-out port is ether2 and it is passive, not 802.3at**: the manual reads "PoE-Out Passive PoE up to 57V", "PoE-Out ports Ether2, max out per port output (input < 30 V): 600 mA, max out per port output (input > 30 V): 400 mA", with the caveat that over 300 mA the box must be fed from the DC jack. The `802.3af`/`802.3at` tokens describe its own PoE-in, not what it sources. An earlier copy (`cap-ax.json`) classed ether2 `PoE+` and listed the radios at 1G; both are corrected here, and that file is absorbed.

poe.note: Total output power 19.2 W and "Total output current 0.4" (product table, PoE-out block); 0.4 A is the manual's >30 V per-port ceiling, and 0.4 A x 48 V = 19.2 W. Manual: https://manual.mikrotik.com/hardware/cap-ax/
